note: first blockout: seat, 4 legs, rail, 3 slats
critique: Technically clean but reads as a modern kitchen chair, not a chunky tavern chair. leg 0.045 -> ~0.07 (spindly); seat_thickness 0.05 -> 0.07; no stretchers (add side + front stretchers low between legs); 3 thin slats -> 2 wide slats (style: fewer, larger forms); top_rail too small -> taller and overhanging the posts; perfectly machined -> jitter, rear posts lean back (shear), front legs splay slightly.
